# Benchmark results

Every benchmark run whose `summary.json` is kept in `bench/records/`, grouped by record. *Clean* is the share
of boards with every connection made and no error added in KiCad's DRC (the judge of D8 and, since
2026-10-14, D106); *FR 2.5* is Freerouting 2.5.0-RC12's published result on the same boards. Each record's
README says what the runs were for and how to read them; numbers from different records are not always
comparable (judge version, time limit, machine load).
